name: ⚔️Swordback
desc:
🗡️ Battle in the Sky! 🌌
Jump from a flying platform, glide into the arena, and fight your way to victory! ⚔️ Use swords to knock your enemies back with ragdoll physics—your % damage increases with every hit, making you fly further! 💥

🏔️ Take control of the pyramid to earn points and unlock powerful new swords! 🗡️ But watch out! Every 2 minutes, a special zone spawns for even more rewards! ✨

🪂 Skydiving, sword fights, and epic battles—can you dominate the skies? 👑

👍 Like and favorite if you enjoy the game! 🚀
